name: local-agent-companion
description: A local LangChain agent foundation for VS Code with user-configured LiteLLM and approval-gated corporate MCP connections.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Local Agent Companion reads project files and can execute explicitly approved local tools, so the workspace must be trusted.

commands.title: Local Agent Companion: Add Selection to Context
Local Agent Companion: Add File to Context
Local Agent Companion: Configure Model Provider
Local Agent Companion: Remove Current Provider Key

enumDescriptions: Corporate or self-hosted LiteLLM gateway. Available in every package.
Local Ollama OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Requires the explicit Ollama VSIX variant.
Direct OpenAI Platform Chat Completions. Requires the explicit OpenAI VSIX variant.
localAgentCompanion.modelProvider.description: Model provider selected for this installation. Optional providers are rejected unless their explicit VSIX variant is installed.

enumDescriptions: Focused LangChain createAgent runtime with explicit local tools and bounded context.
Advanced createDeepAgent runtime with planning support, context compaction, workspace filesystem tools, and local subagents.
localAgentCompanion.agentRuntime.description: Agent runtime used for this workspace. Both options use the selected Chat Completions provider.

enumDescriptions: Ask before every workspace mutation and command.
Apply scoped file and project-memory edits automatically; commands and deletions still require approval.
Inspect and plan with read-only tools; do not mutate the workspace or run commands.
localAgentCompanion.autonomyMode.description: Default autonomy level for new Local Agent Companion requests in this workspace.

localAgentCompanion.liteLlmEndpoint.description: Selected provider base URL or complete Chat Completions URL. OpenAI is fixed to api.openai.com; Ollama is restricted to loopback.

enumDescriptions: Send the key as Authorization: Bearer, the standard LiteLLM mode.
Send the key in the api-key header used by Azure-compatible gateways.
Send the key in the default Azure API Management subscription header.
localAgentCompanion.liteLlmAuthHeader.description: HTTP header used to authenticate the Chat Completions request.

localAgentCompanion.liteLlmModel.description: Exact model or gateway alias used by the selected provider.

localAgentCompanion.liteLlmModelsEndpoin.description: Optional HTTPS model-catalog URL queried with Cache-Control: no-cache and the stored key in the api-key header.

localAgentCompanion.liteLlmModelProfiles.description: Optional Chat Completions parameters stored per exact model alias. Missing fields are omitted from the request. Prefer the LiteLLM form in the Local Agent Companion sidebar.

localAgentCompanion.gatewayCaCertificate.description: Legacy workspace-relative corporate CA PEM path. Existing values are migrated automatically to the extension's global local storage.

localAgentCompanion.autoContext.description: Include the active file, selection, diagnostics and workspace summary with each request.

localAgentCompanion.maxContextCharacters.description: Maximum number of characters collected from the editor for one request.

localAgentCompanion.maxConversationChara.description: Maximum number of recent conversation characters retained as model context.

enumDescriptions: Notify only when the Local Agent Companion sidebar is not visible.
Notify after every completed or failed run.
Never show run-completion notifications.
localAgentCompanion.completionNotificati.description: Controls local VS Code notifications after completed or failed agent runs. Notifications never include request, response, project, path, or model content.

localAgentCompanion.semanticMemoryEnable.description: Use the bundled local ChromaDB vector store to retrieve relevant entries from project memory. Requires an embedding model alias.

localAgentCompanion.embeddingModel.description: Selected-provider model used only for embeddings. Leave blank to use memory.md without semantic retrieval.

localAgentCompanion.semanticMemoryResult.description: Maximum number of semantically relevant project-memory chunks injected into a run.

localAgentCompanion.standardRecursionLim.description: LangGraph recursion limit for the standard runtime. Deep Agent uses its own high native limit and compaction behavior.

enumDescriptions: Do not make a separate completion-review model call.
Review runs that changed files or collected execution, diagnostic, process, or browser evidence.
Review every executable agent run.
localAgentCompanion.finalReviewMode.description: Optional independent final review through the same selected Chat Completions provider. No additional service is contacted.

localAgentCompanion.localBrowserToolsEna.description: Allow the agent to request approval-gated LangChain tools for inspecting and visually checking applications on localhost. Toggle this from the browser icon in the sidebar. Non-loopback browser traffic is blocked.

enumDescriptions: Try the installed browser most common on this operating system, then the other supported browser.
Use an installed Microsoft Edge.
Use an installed Google Chrome.
localAgentCompanion.localBrowserChannel.description: Installed browser used for local app validation. The extension never downloads a browser.

localAgentCompanion.localBrowserExecutab.description: Optional absolute path to a corporate Chromium-based browser. Leave blank to find installed Edge or Chrome automatically.

localAgentCompanion.localBrowserOpenPrev.description: Ask VS Code to open the same localhost URL for the user when the agent starts an isolated validation session. VS Code 1.109+ opens localhost links in the integrated browser by default.

scripts.test: npm run compile:tests && node --test dist-tests/test/**/*.test.js && npm run test:repository
scripts.test:repository: node --test test/issue-forms.test.mjs test/license-inventory.test.mjs test/native-package.test.mjs test/release-metadata.test.mjs test/security-audit.test.mjs
scripts.test:extension-host: npm run build && npm run compile:extension-host-tests && node scripts/run-extension-host-tests.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke:litellm && npm run smoke:chroma
scripts.package:verified:ollama: npm run verify && node esbuild.mjs --provider=ollama && node scripts/package-native.mjs --provider=ollama
scripts.package:verified:openai: npm run verify && node esbuild.mjs --provider=openai && node scripts/package-native.mjs --provider=openai
